name: Tavily
summary: Search, extract and crawl the web.
description: Tavily's hosted server searches the web, extracts page content and crawls sites.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.tavily.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
